children: Adani Enterprises Limited (NSE:ADANIENT) is expanding into AI and hyperscale data centres via a 50:50 JV with Jabil and AdaniConneX with EdgeConneX while funding growth—₹17,000 crore airports capex, ₹20bn short‑term bonds, renewable and smelter expansion, plus staged rehab tower handovers.
Adani Enterprises Signs MoU With Jabil
: Adani Enterprises (ADANIENT) signed a non‑binding MoU with Jabil to form a 50:50 JV in India to design and make AI/data‑centre racks, servers, storage and cooling systems; subject to approvals.
: Adani Enterprises (ADANIENT) partners with EdgeConneX in AdaniConneX to build a nationwide hyperscale data‑centre network, deploying sites including Visakhapatnam to support cloud and AI services.

: Adani Enterprises (ADANIENT) plans ~₹17,000 crore of FY27 capex for Adani Airports to upgrade infrastructure and build a new Ahmedabad terminal; targets passenger capacity growth from ~95M to 150M+.
: Adani Enterprises (ADANIENT) plans to raise ~20 billion rupees via short-term bonds maturing under five years this quarter to fund general corporate purposes; offering is debt, not equity.
: Adani Enterprises (ADANIENT) via Kutch Copper will add 115 MW renewable power at Mundra and aims to double copper smelter capacity from 0.5Mtpa to 1Mtpa at the Mundra refinery.
Adani Enterprises To Handover Rehab Towers
: Adani Enterprises (ADANIENT) will hand over 10 rehab towers in phases: 5 by March 2029, 2 by August 2029, and the final 3 by August 2030.
